description: Use this when the person says they are worn out, working very long hours, or worried about burnout. Checks work days, late nights and meeting load, then gives a risk score and specific recovery actions. Until Andru has their activity or calendar data, it says the risk is not scored yet.

mode.description: assessment = burnout risk score + recommendations. dashboard = full wellness data. Default: assessment.

name: get_founder_wellness
title: Check burnout risk
